evidence.title: Think Only When Needed: Prompt-Authority Control for Selective Slow-Path Intervention in Vision-Language-Action Manipulation

summary: Researchers introduced a prompt‑authority control mechanism that dynamically routes inputs to a heavyweight slow‑path module only for challenging vision‑language‑action tasks, reducing unnecessary computation. Experiments show the approach maintains performance while cutting inference cost by up to 40 %.
title: Prompt-Authority Framework Lets Vision‑Language‑Action Models Invoke Slow‑Path Processing Only When Needed
